meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把 LazyCodex 或 Codex 的 bug 整理成一条带运行时与源码证据的 GitHub issue(必要时对 openai/codex 提 PR),内含复现步骤、根因、修复建议,并判断该发到哪个仓库。
howto.when: 当你要求报告、提交或分流 LazyCodex、Codex 插件、上游 Codex CLI 的 bug 时触发。

say.text: 报一个 LazyCodex 安装器的 bug:装完后 skill 不生效
say.note: 会先复现并判定归属仓库,再开 issue

say.text: 上游 Codex CLI 在干净环境下也崩,帮我提个 issue
say.note: 归属 openai/codex,必要时可提 PR

say.text: 查一下 openai/codex 有没有相同 issue,有就补充证据
say.note: 已有匹配 issue 时改为在下面评论

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude turns a LazyCodex or Codex bug into one evidence-backed GitHub issue (or a PR to openai/codex when allowed), with reproduction steps, root cause, fix guidance, and a repository routing decision.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug.

say_en.text: File a LazyCodex installer bug: skills do not load after install
say_en.note: Reproduces first, decides the repo, then opens the issue.

say_en.text: Plain Codex CLI crashes too - open an upstream issue
say_en.note: Routes to openai/codex; a PR is possible there.

say_en.text: Check openai/codex for a matching issue and add my evidence
say_en.note: Comments on the existing issue instead of duplicating.
